limitations: Only ordinary minimum zero forcing under one-token adjacent slides without spare tokens; no claim about nonminimum configurations, buffer thresholds, other forcing variants, or unrestricted classification of all optimal sets. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
scientific_integrity: The parity balance and token-slide impossibility are proved for every integer hypercube dimension d>=2 by a symbolic signed-adjacency nullity argument. The known minimum size and existing finite counts are explicitly credited; accompanying code checks finite instances only. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Every minimum zero-forcing set of a binary hypercube is parity-balanced and frozen under token sliding
